memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, works as lab technician, walks to college.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds, fall risk low.
medicines: 2 regular (silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD); polypharmacy no, but review against Beers criteria advised due to long-term statin use.
mood: reports good mood, denies anxiety or carer strain.
carers: mother Lakshmi, lives with patient.
goal: "I want to stay healthy and keep working without liver problems."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: liver shows mild diffuse hepatic steatosis, no focal lesion, spleen normal, portal vein patent, no ascites. Impression: consistent with non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease, grade 1.
